relations.subject: James Mallinson
relations.evidence: This book is a revision of my doctoral thesis, which I submitted for examination in 2003. The enthusiasm of my teachers and fellow indologists in Oxford was a constant source of inspiration.

relations.subject: James Mallinson
relations.evidence: Firstly, I want to thank my thesis supervisor Professor Sanderson who was always ready to help me with his encyclopedic knowledge.

relations.subject: James Mallinson
relations.evidence: From outside of Oxford I thank Christian Bouy, whose work inspired me to start the thesis and who has helped in my search for sources
